newsitem.title: USA: Audio King October same store sales fall.
newsitem.headline: Audio King October same store sales fall.

text.p: Audio King Corp, a specialty retailer of consumer electronics, said Wednesday its comparable store sales in October fell 13 percent from the same month a year ago.
"October sales results reflect the continuation of the poor trends in the consumer electronics marketplace," Audio King president Gary Thorne said in a statement.
Total sales in October declined 12 percent to $4.8 million from October 1995 sales of $5.5 million.

Comparable store sales for the October year-to-date were down two percent from last year. Total sales of $21 million were up one percent from October 1995 year-to-date sales of $20.8 million, the retailer said.
Audio King operates 11 retail stores -- eight in Minnesota, one in South Dakota and two in Iowa -- and operates a large independent audio/video electronics repair service inthe Midwest.
Shares of Audio King closed off 3/32 at 1-13/32.
